AND cp.region = #{region}
AND cp.post_type = #{type}
AND cp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND cp.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ct.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc2 WHERE cc2.post_id = cp.post_id AND cc2.comment_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'BLOCKED') AND cc2.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.nickname, cp.title, cp.content, cp.post_status, cp.view_count, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.report_count, cp.created_at, cp.post_type, cp.region, cp.tip_category, cpi.image_url AS thumb_url, u.account_status, SUM(ctr.co_count) AS total_co_count FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE cpi ON cp.post_id = cpi.post_id AND cpi.sort_order = 1 JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_TAG cpt_other ON cp.post_id = cpt_other.post_id JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_TAG cpt_mine ON cpt_mine.post_id = #{postId} JOIN COMMUNITY_TAG_RELATION ctr ON ( (ctr.tag_id_a = cpt_mine.tag_id AND ctr.tag_id_b = cpt_other.tag_id) OR (ctr.tag_id_b = cpt_mine.tag_id AND ctr.tag_id_a = cpt_other.tag_id) ) WHERE cp.post_status = 'ACTIVE' AND cp.post_id != #{postId} GROUP BY cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.nickname, cp.title, cp.content, cp.post_status, cp.view_count, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.report_count, cp.created_at, cp.post_type, cp.region, cp.tip_category, cpi.image_url, u.account_status ORDER BY total_co_count DESC, cp.like_count DESC, cp.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
